errors.evidence: The description claims that the countries on the x-axis are sorted alphabetically. However, the chart shows they are sorted in ascending order of their percentage values, from Finland (lowest) to Bulgaria (highest).
The description states that the value for Bulgaria reaches 60%. The bar for Bulgaria is clearly below the 60% line, at approximately 59%.
